description:
Group every GoF2 mesh (resources.json meshes[] + FBX files without a resources entry)
by base name using the original suffix conventions. Writes name_groups.json.

Two levels:
  layer group : name minus trailing render-layer tokens (_add _alpha _emissive _lookat _anim
                _lights _engine _glow _shadow) and _lod_N  -> meshes that are drawn together
                as ONE object (same transform), e.g. ship_004 + _lights_add + _engine_add + _lod_1.
  family      : a layer group whose base is '<other base>_<extra>' where <other base> is an
                existing layer group is attached to it as a sub-part (_gun, _x1, _bot_a,
                _explosion, _wrecked, _damaged, _part1, _container, _jump, _laser, _fire ...).

ambiguous.bar_visitor: bar_visitor_glow / bar_visitor_shadow are NOT layers of one object: _glow/_shadow here are standalone meshes placed under each bar visitor (Level::createScene mode 4). bar_visitor_glow has 4 ids (one per bar race, different materials).
ambiguous.bar_midorian: no plain main mesh; bar_midorian_anim is the room mesh; bar_midorian_alpha_anim (0x36d6) is a separate animated object created by CutScene::initialize, not a layer of the room.
ambiguous.hangar_midorian: resources ids 14401/14402 point to hangar_midorian_x5(+shadow) a second time; hangar_midorian_x6(+shadow) FBX exist but have no resource id (original table bug or intentional). Child range in code is 12 ids from 14391.
ambiguous.map_planet: not a group: map_planet_NNN are separate planets (id 18180+textureIndex). main/map_planet_020..022 FBX are unreferenced; ids 18200..18202 map to valkyrie v_map_planet_020..022.
ambiguous.map_sun: map_sun_000..010 + sn_map_sun_011 FBX are unreferenced: the galaxy map draws suns with plane.fbx ids 18070+textureIndex (per-id material).
ambiguous.lens_flare: lens_flare_0/1/2 are independent flare sprites (no FBX, resource ids only), grouped only by the _N sibling rule.
ambiguous.map_fog_layer: galaxy map: map_bg_plane (16850) + map_fog_layer_0 (16851) + map_fog_layer_1 (16852) are 3 separate geometries, all at (-3000,-2500,0) rot (0,pi,0) (StarMap::init).
ambiguous.sn_carrier_terran: sn_carrier_terran_1/2/3 (+_emissive) look like hull sections; sn_carrier_terran_lights_add has no numbered main. How they are combined is not verified here (see flight-scene research).
ambiguous.explosion: 1-token families (explosion_debris, explosion_emp, ...) are NOT merged into explosion: they are different effects.
ambiguous.plane: plane.fbx is shared by many ids (galaxy-map suns 18070.., 6768 system-view sun, ...) each with its own material; it is one mesh, many materials.

subpartLegend.layers (add/alpha/emissive/lights/engine: same object, same transform, different material/blend; *_anim = has keyframes; *_lookat = billboard
subpartLegend.lod N: alternative mesh for distance N (lod 0 = the plain name)
subpartLegend.gun: separately rotating child (turret gun), see CutScene::checkForTurret / PlayerTurret
subpartLegend.x1..x6 (hangars): static children added under the hangar room (Level::createScene mode 0x17)
subpartLegend.bot_*: separate animated props (hangar bots are NOT created by any code in this build; bar_terran_bot is)
subpartLegend.explosion / wrecked / damaged / fire / s: alternate-state or effect objects shown by game logic, not permanent children
subpartLegend.partN / N: sections of one object without a main mesh

notes: no plain main mesh; bar_midorian_anim is the room mesh; bar_midorian_alpha_anim (0x36d6) is a separate animated object created by CutScene::initialize, not a layer of the room.
